title: CobbleGamble
description: A Cobblemon casino — Poker, Roulette, Coin Flip & Races with CobbleDollars.
body:
# 🎰 Gamble Pokemon

Bring a full casino to your Cobblemon server! **Gamble Pokemon** adds a suite of
gambling games where players wager their **CobbleDollars** at custom table blocks
tended by dealer villagers — with a saturated, Stake-style casino interface, live
spectating, win fireworks, per-player stat tracking, and placeable richest-players
and gambling-stats leaderboards.

**Five playable games:** American Roulette, single-player **Blackjack**, a 1v1 Coin
Flip duel, a multiplayer Pokemon Race, and full multiplayer **Texas Hold'em Poker**.

> ⚠️ **Client + server mod.** The games use custom blocks and custom screens, so it
> must be installed on **both the server and every player's client** (add it to your
> modpack). It is not server-only.

## 🎮 Games

### 🎡 Roulette — American (0 and 00)
A full **American double-zero** wheel (38 pockets) with an animated HD spin and a
Crazy-Time-style flapper pointer. Pick a chip and place it on numbers, red/black,
odds/evens, dozens, or columns, then hit **SPIN**. True American payouts — straight
up **35:1**, columns/dozens **2:1**, even-money **1:1** — with the standard **5.26%**
house edge. Bet against the house.

### ♠️ Blackjack — vs the House
Classic single-player Blackjack against the dealer, in a matching casino table. **Hit,
Stand, or Double Down**; the dealer stands on 17 and a natural **Blackjack pays 3:2**.
Win a hand and press **Double or Nothing** to stake your winnings on a fresh hand —
double them or lose the lot, and keep riding the streak as long as you dare.

### 🪙 Coin Flip — 1v1 PvP
Two players sit at the same table and put up an **equal wager**. Place your chips on
Heads or Tails, then watch a smooth coin-toss animation decide it — the **winner takes
the whole pot**. Pure player-vs-player, no house edge.

### 🏁 Cobble Race — PvP
Up to **6 players** join a booth as racers and wager the same amount (equal odds).
Watch a live animated race around an oval track with real lead changes and nail-biting
photo finishes. The **winner takes the entire pot**.

### ♠️ Texas Hold'em Poker — Multiplayer
A fully playable, Stake-style poker table for up to **8 players**. Buy in with
CobbleDollars, post blinds, and play real hands: **fold / check / call / raise / all-in**,
proper **side pots**, and showdown with live hand-strength readouts. Ring the table with
**sittable poker benches** and deal your friends in.

## ✨ Features

* 💰 **CobbleDollars economy** — bets use the same currency as the rest of your server
* 📊 **Gambling stats** — every wager is tracked per player and saved across restarts:
  net profit, total gained/lost, biggest win, biggest loss, games played, and win/loss
  record. Check yours (or anyone's) with `/gamblestats`
* 🏆 **Two kinds of leaderboards** — floating in-world holograms *and* chat commands:
  * **Richest players** — `/gpleaderboard place` shows the live **Top 10** CobbleDollars
    balances (online *and* offline), refreshing continuously
  * **Gambling stats** — `/gpstatsboard place <category>` and `/gamblestats top …` rank
    the **Top 10** for Most Gained, Most Lost, Highest Profit, Most Wagered, or Most Wins
* 🎉 **Win celebrations** — an on-screen burst + sound *and* real **in-world fireworks**
  launch above the winner (timed so they never spoil the result)
* 👀 **Live spectator mode** — **sneak + right-click** any table or dealer to watch a game
  live from the side (Roulette, Coin Flip, Race, Poker; you only ever see face-up/showdown
  cards, never anyone's hole cards)
* 🪑 **Sittable poker benches** — right-click to sit around the table
* 🧑‍💼 **Dealer villagers** spawn at each table, labeled by their game — right-click the
  dealer or the table to play
* 🎨 **Casino-style UI** — saturated Stake/Rainbet-inspired menus, bold text, glowing
  buttons, and custom card, chip, and felt artwork, consistent across every game
* 🎰 **Chip denominations** from **1k to 1M**, with a **configurable max bet** (default 5M)
* 🔒 **Money-safe** — chips are deducted when placed and **refunded** if you leave without
  playing; poker cash-outs and uncalled bets are returned correctly

## 🧱 Blocks

Found under Creative → **Functional Blocks**:

| Block | ID |
|---|---|
| Roulette Table | `gamblepokemon:roulette_table` |
| Blackjack Table | `gamblepokemon:blackjack_table` |
| Coin Flip Table | `gamblepokemon:coinflip_table` |
| Race Booth | `gamblepokemon:race_booth` |
| Poker Table | `gamblepokemon:circle_table` |
| Poker Bench | `gamblepokemon:poker_bench` |

## ⌨️ Commands

* `/roulette` — open the roulette table
* `/gamblestats` — view your gambling stats
* `/gamblestats <player>` — view another player's stats
* `/gamblestats top <lost|gained|profit|wagered|wins>` — top-10 stat leaderboard in chat
* `/gpleaderboard place` — drop a live richest-players hologram where you stand *(op)*
* `/gpleaderboard remove` — remove the nearest richest-players hologram *(op)*
* `/gpstatsboard place <category>` — drop a live gambling-stats hologram *(op)*
* `/gpstatsboard remove` — remove the nearest stats hologram *(op)*

## ⚙️ Config

A config file is generated at `config/gamblepokemon.json` on first launch:

```json
{
  "maxBet": 5000000
}
